Detox
Individual Variety

Raphanus sativus

China Rose Radish

Higher Vitamin C & anthocyanins vs white radish; gentler heat profile

A vibrant detox booster with a smooth peppery kick. China Rose offers a balanced crunch with a refreshing, mildly sweet finish.

Key Compound

Anthocyanins + Glucosinolates

Select Size

Why China Rose Radish?

Fat Loss & DetoxBoosts metabolismSupports digestionHigh in Vitamin C

How to Consume

  • •The milder heat makes China Rose ideal for people new to radish microgreens
  • •Use raw as a garnish or salad base to preserve both flavour and sulforaphane
  • •The pink stems make it visually striking on plates — great for smoothie bowls

Key Bioactives

Glucoraphenin

Liver detox support via sulforaphane activation; milder flavour compared to purple varieties

Anthocyanins (cyanidin derivatives)

The pink-to-red pigmentation in China Rose stems directly signals higher anthocyanin content — potent antioxidants that reduce oxidative stress and support cardiovascular health

Phenolic compounds

Anti-inflammatory; shown in vitro to inhibit cancer cell proliferation
